commands: git fetch origin main && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "b9e165f13841c8b4dc0f65eae77c5dc3e0e460eb" && git status --short
echo '--- restart and console references ---'; git grep -n -E 'esp_restart|restart|reboot|ServiceConsole|service console' -- src components lib tools scripts Makefile docs || true
echo '--- serial monitor references ---'; git grep -n -E 'idf.py monitor|esp_idf_monitor|DTR|RTS|hupcl|HUPCL|usbserial-1130' -- Makefile scripts tools docs config src components lib || true
echo '--- console-like files ---'; find src components lib tools -type f | grep -Ei 'console|serial|diagnostic' | sort || true

echo '--- installed monitor help ---'; if command -v idf.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then idf.py monitor --help | sed -n '1,220p'; elif python3 -m esp_idf_monitor --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m esp_idf_monitor --help | sed -n '1,220p'; else echo IDF_MONITOR_NOT_ON_DEFAULT_PATH; fi
echo '--- pyserial version ---'; python3 -c 'import serial; print(serial.VERSION)'; echo '--- stty settings supported ---'; stty -a </dev/null 2>&1 || true
